summary: This document specifies how to send IPv6 packets over ITU-T G.9959 networks, which are low-power wireless networks used for things like home automation. It defines the frame format and how to form link-local and stateless autoconfigured IPv6 addresses.

eli5.summary: Tiny wireless gadgets in a house, like sensors and switches, can learn to speak internet language. This document tells them how to wrap their messages and make their own addresses.
